title: 連接倒裝(Not only… / No sooner…)

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Not only did it go well, but we also got great press.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: No sooner had we finished than the first order came in.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Only then did we realise how big this was.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Not only was it cheap, but it also worked.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Only after lunch did he call.
